rows.requirement: Keep source assumptions separate from environmental exposure
rows.quantity: reference/model context versus actual episode and exposure custody
rows.prospective_method: Identify which statements are model/reference assumptions and which separately recorded episode would supply actual exposure. Existing model pressure or atmosphere assumptions do not observe icing, lightning or hail; no atmosphere formula, table or comparison is repeated.
rows.rejection_condition: A reference atmosphere, model assumption or repository gate treated as environmental exposure, or Q18 analysis duplicated.

rows.quantity: time, location, duration and recorded ambient state
rows.prospective_method: Retain a configuration-bound exposure record with synchronized time/location and applicable measured state; unavailable fields remain missing. This paper selects no weather envelope or operating limit.
rows.rejection_condition: Unmatched time/location, undocumented ambient state, live forecast substituted for exposure or a limit selected here.

rows.quantity: article identity, installed configuration and inclusion boundary
rows.prospective_method: Bind exposure and response to the actual article, geometry, interfaces and installed equipment state. Conceptual drawing/bill records are provenance context rather than weather-tested hardware.
rows.rejection_condition: Rendered geometry or a model bill substituted for an exposed built article, differing configurations merged or unknown counterparts set to zero.

rows.requirement: Identify actual surface and material state
rows.quantity: surface/material identity, condition and exposure history
rows.prospective_method: Retain actual material/surface condition, interfaces and preceding exposure history for the same article; no material or treatment is chosen.
rows.rejection_condition: Unidentified surface state, a schematic film treated as a measured membrane, a nominal material assumed to have demonstrated response or a treatment selected here.

rows.requirement: Identify installed equipment and protection provenance
rows.quantity: actual installed equipment/protection and inclusion record
rows.prospective_method: Record any actual protection and equipment provenance with its inclusion boundary and supporting evidence. Existence and applicability remain unknown; this paper chooses no protective hardware or architecture.
rows.rejection_condition: Protection assumed present or adequate, absent record interpreted as no protection, nominal equipment credited as response evidence or hardware selected here.

rows.requirement: Retain the missing icing exposure evidence
rows.quantity: article-bound icing exposure and source custody
rows.prospective_method: Retain separately authorized raw icing exposure custody and matched article/surface/episode identity; no icing state, accumulation or load is calculated or specified here.
rows.rejection_condition: An assumed reference state credited as icing exposure, unrecorded exposure presumed benign or an icing envelope/limit supplied.

rows.requirement: Retain the missing icing response evidence
rows.quantity: observed response under the matched icing exposure
rows.prospective_method: Retain actual response and observation custody under the identified exposure and configuration, with calibration/uncertainty unavailable until sourced.
rows.rejection_condition: An illustration, prediction or generic model check called observed icing response, absent response treated as success or a performance/safety claim made.

rows.requirement: Retain missing lightning exposure and response separately
rows.quantity: actual exposure identity and calibrated article/equipment response
rows.prospective_method: Keep the actual lightning exposure/stimulus record separate from response and protection provenance, linked only by matched article and episode. No electrical load, protective hardware or acceptance threshold is supplied.
rows.rejection_condition: Exposure inferred from a reference atmosphere, protection presence substituted for response, missing channels set to zero or electrical loads/limits calculated.

rows.requirement: Retain missing hail exposure and response separately
rows.quantity: actual exposure identity and calibrated surface/article response
rows.prospective_method: Keep actual hail exposure custody separate from matched surface/article response and prior condition. No impact load, damage prediction, material selection or operational threshold is supplied.
rows.rejection_condition: Generic material/drawing record called hail evidence, unknown damage assumed absent, unmatched surface state or impact/operating limits invented.

rows.requirement: Keep observation custody, calibration and uncertainty unresolved
rows.quantity: raw exposure/response records, clocks, calibration and uncertainty provenance
rows.prospective_method: Retain immutable raw records and matched calibration/clock/uncertainty provenance before interpreting any separately authorized observation. No band or numeric uncertainty is supplied here.
rows.rejection_condition: Published assumption or repository signature called calibrated evidence, unsourced uncertainty supplied or unavailable record hidden as zero.

rows.requirement: Keep hazard-specific criteria and acceptance unresolved
rows.quantity: already-published criterion wording, adopted scope, accountable owner and decision
rows.prospective_method: Index applicable existing hazard-specific wording only when a source locator supplies it. The assigned sources name a gap and supply no applicable hazard response criterion; adoption, assigned owner and acceptance stay missing.
rows.rejection_condition: Gap wording or generic structural criterion promoted to icing/lightning/hail acceptance, new threshold chosen, unassigned owner inferred or compliance/safety asserted.

missing_semantics: Missing actual exposure, response, configuration, material state, protection, calibration, uncertainty, adopted criterion and acceptance remain null/UNKNOWN. Unlocated evidence and criterion explicitly absent in the assigned source trace only; assignee null/UNASSIGNED.
scope: Only icing/lightning/hail source gaps and prospective evidence custody; no gust/mooring/ground-handling, thermal/noise, Q18 duplication, computation, protective choice, operating limit, new threshold, simulation/test, live forecast, private result, safety/compliance or source change.
